featured_reviews.review_text:
I have purchased a vacuum pump and a turbo charger pressure converter from them. Vacuum pump was purchased few months back. I was initially not very comfortable placing the order as seller was unknown to me. Had a chat with the seller over WhatsApp and seller assured that I will be provided with the order number and tracking details. He also provided me the pictures of the part over WhatsApp since I was sceptical initially.

Went ahead and transferred the amount via UPI. Seller shipped the part on the same day and provided me with the tracking number. There was no delay in the shipment and package reached on time. The product that I ordered was aftermarket, but made in Germany. It looked exactly identical to the OEM part. I have done the replacement and so far no issues.

Second order was placed two days back. Seller provided me the pictures of the part before shipment and the shipment was done on the very same day of payment.

Based on the two orders that I have done, they have a very very reasonable and attractive pricing and is much better than other vendors. Will sure use Arihant auto house services in future as well

As per our return policy, you had the option to return the part and choose something else. Instead, you chose a replacement. That was your decision, not ours.

Let me make one thing absolutely clear: we do not sell fake products. Our reputation is built on trust and integrity, and we take that very seriously. Yes, I admit to mistakenly providing you with the wrong clutch bearing because mistakes can happen. But twisting facts and making false claims to tarnish our name is unacceptable and unethical.

I expect you to take accountability for your actions and refrain from spreading baseless accusations that harm my business.
